name: Brandelia
business: A small flower studio: hand-tied bouquets in three sizes, a handwritten card with every order, delivery windows with a cutoff, payment by phone after the order.
moment: Someone sending flowers to someone else, usually with a feeling attached and a date in mind. The order needs an occasion, a bouquet and size, a card message, a delivery window and the recipient.
homePattern: An occasion deck: the question "Who are the flowers for?", then tall photo cards to swipe through (love, a birthday, thank you, a new baby...), then the delivery windows still open today as one ruled line.

elements.notes: The deck: a horizontal snap scroller of tall 4:5 photo cards with the word over a gradient and a numbered corner; the open delivery windows line is bound live from delivery_slots (available rows from today on, two at most) and taps through to the delivery screen.

Exactly one bouquet: a full-bleed photo with the name and live price over it, the description large, hairline In the bouquet / Palette and life columns, size tiles that change the price, a lined paper card for the message, one button that carries size, price and message into the delivery step.

Windows grouped by day with a rule and "N open", large tabular times, zone and fee in small caps, "3 left, order by 14:00" in italic; a sold-out window stays visible, struck through and disabled. A tap carries the slot id into the order.
